articles.description: Israel says the attacks on the Lebanese capital were ordered  "in response to Hezbollah's firing at Israeli territory".

articles.title: Steve Rosenberg: Russia's economic forum overshadowed by drone attacks on St Petersburg
articles.description: The BBC's Russia editor saw Putin's flagship economic event overshadowed by Ukrainian drones attacks.

articles.title: Hegseth attacks Europe over migration with beach 'invasion' D-Day speech
articles.description: The US defence secretary was speaking in Normandy, 82 years after allied forces launched their operation to liberate Nazi-occupied north-western Europe.

articles.title: North Korea will never surrender nuclear status, Kim Jong Un's sister says
articles.description: The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has declared that the country will never surrender its nuclear-armed status and continue to expand its atomic arsenal.

articles.title: Hegseth uses D-Day speech to issue immigration warning
articles.description: Pete Hegseth has warned Europe is facing "an invasion of dangerous ideologies" arriving by sea, as he linked immigration to the legacy of the D-Day landings in Normandy.

articles.title: Man dies after shark attack in Australia
articles.description: A man has died after being attacked by a shark while fishing off Australia's southwestern coast, police say.

articles.title: Technical issue detected on one of UK's biggest warships
articles.description: A technical issue has been detected on one of the UK's largest warships as it was docked in Norway, the Ministry of Defence (MoD) said.
